newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's Jan-April coffee output down sharply.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's Jan-April coffee output down sharply.

text.p: Colombia produced 2.7 million 60-kg bags of coffee between January and April against 3.7 million bags in the same period last year, according to official figures made available Wednesday by National Coffee Growers' Federation.

The figures were provided to Reuters a day after the federation's general manager, Jorge Cardenas, told reporters the federation was having "enormous difficulties" meeting its export commitments because of unusually tight supply.
"There's very little coffee in Colombia. The federation is having enormous difficulties meeting its commitments," Cardenas said.

He acknowledged for the first time that the country had fallen behind on its coffee export schedules for April because of the shortfall in production and said Colombia's coffee industry was passing through an "extremely difficult" time despite the recent run-up in world prices. ((--Juan Guillermo Londoo, Bogota newsroom, 571 610 7944))
